digest.component_or_area: operation-certificate trust model documentation and docstrings
propositions: Maintained documentation and docstrings describe plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based, contradicting the implemented asymmetric DSSE/SSHSIG operation-certificate model in ADR 0049

Candidate files (attest-substrate.md, config.md, exit-codes.md, identity.md, llm-framework.md, _lib_identity.py, _mcp_reads.py, resign.py) contain stale HMAC terminology that must be corrected to reflect current Ed25519 and environment attribution

Generated reference documentation (mcp-reference.md, cli-reference.md) must be regenerated through canonical sources (gen_mcp_reference.py, gen_cli_reference.py) after docstring updates to remain current

Legacy HMAC plan-review and completion-verifier records must be documented as readable but unable to certify current gated operations, while generic HMAC helpers remain supported for non-gate consumers
Historical records (ADRs, migrations, experiment corpora) and generic HMAC API documentation must remain unchanged and untouched by this correction effort
